When exactly will my pre-order ship?

Reply to any order email or call the store before your next ship date. No cancellation fees, no retention scripts, no hassle.

What if CuraMed's price changes?

Your bundle price is the price you reserved at. If the retail price ever changes, we'll email you before your next charge — never after.
